notes: Game Anatomy Jam entry titled Not All Heroes Wear Swords. Complete Unity 2021.2 project (Assets+ProjectSettings+Packages) with MainMenu, Main, sewing/quenching minigames, GameOver, and Victory scenes. Code is MIT (Copyright 2022 Christian Chaux). Assets are CC-BY-4.0 per the itch.io page https://zirk.itch.io/not-all-heroes-wear-swords, which credits authors Zirk, Blauenzag, Gradkal, loge0, and Blast-SD. GitHub contributors also include fox2402, loge0, Skulth, and AmayaHena. Official Unity packages only (2D, Input System, TextMeshPro as a package with no vendored fonts, Visual Scripting). No bundled fonts, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no Asset Store packages, no LFS. ~5.9M src snapshot.
